# BenefitsPRO

> > BenefitsPRO delivers news, analysis, and insights on employee benefits, healthcare, insurance, and financial services for benefits professionals and advisors.

The site covers employee benefits administration, healthcare costs, insurance marketing, and regulatory developments. It also features historical credit union industry coverage including CUNA, NCUA, and federal regulatory matters affecting financial services providers.

## Key Topics

- Employee Benefits
- Healthcare Costs
- Benefits Administration
- Insurance Marketing
- Credit Unions
- Federal Reserve
- CUNA
- NCUA
- Financial Services
- Regulatory Compliance
- Overhead Transfer Rate (OTR)
- Privacy Notices (GLBA)
- Retirement Plans (457 plans)
- Co-op Advertising
- Special Reports

## Regulatory & Compliance

- [Amend Reg Z rules to apply to 0% auto financing, CUNA urges Fed](https://www.benefitspro.com/2001/12/18/amend-reg-z-rules-to-apply-to-0-auto-financing-cuna-urges-fed): CUNA urges Federal Reserve to amend Regulation Z for 0% auto financing
- [Educators and advocates tell financial industry how to clean up privacy notices](https://www.benefitspro.com/2001/12/11/educators-and-advocates-tell-financial-industry-how-to-clean-up-privacy-notices): NCUA and regulators workshop focuses on improving GLBA privacy notices
- [NCUA OTR survey needs updating](https://www.benefitspro.com/2001/11/06/ncua-otr-survey-needs-updating): Deloitte study finds NCUA overhead transfer rate setting needs tweaks
- [Overhead transfer rate acrimony comes to a head](https://www.benefitspro.com/2001/12/18/overhead-transfer-rate-acrimony-comes-to-a-head): NCUA Board raises overhead transfer rate to 66.72% amid industry concerns
- [Fed implements check modernization plan](https://www.benefitspro.com/2001/11/27/fed-implements-check-modernization-plan): Federal Reserve launches initiative to modernize paper check processing

## Credit Union Industry Leadership & News

- [Stan Hollen stepping down from top spot at The Golden 1 CU](https://www.benefitspro.com/2001/12/18/stan-hollen-stepping-down-from-top-spot-at-the-golden-1-cu): Stan Hollen retires as CEO of $3.7B The Golden 1 Credit Union after 17 years
- [Buddle, Ogata and Rissel join CUES Hall of Fame](https://www.benefitspro.com/2001/11/06/buddle-ogata-and-rissel-join-cues-hall-of-fame): Three credit union CEOs inducted into CUES Hall of Fame at Las Vegas ceremony
- [NY Assembly Speaker recognizes role of League, CUs in post-Sept. 11th efforts](https://www.benefitspro.com/2001/11/20/ny-assembly-speaker-recognizes-role-of-league-cus-in-post-sept-11th-efforts): NY Assembly Speaker Silver commends credit unions for Sept. 11th recovery work
- [Alaska League goes all-volunteer](https://www.benefitspro.com/2001/12/18/alaska-league-goes-all-volunteer): Alaska Credit Union League transitions to all-volunteer organization model

- [FORUM Solutions: A tech-savvy CU that made good](https://www.benefitspro.com/2001/11/13/forum-solutions-a-tech-savvy-cu-that-made-good): FORUM Credit Union launches tech CUSO with seven full-time employees
- [InfiCorp adds two Maine CUs to its growing family](https://www.benefitspro.com/2001/11/20/inficorp-adds-two-maine-cus-to-its-growing-family): InfiCorp acquires $7.5M credit card portfolios from two Maine credit unions
- [Two more California FCUs convert to state charters](https://www.benefitspro.com/2001/11/20/two-more-california-fcus-convert-to-state-charters): California DFI approves federal-to-state conversions for two credit unions
- [Deluxe training tool helps boost member satisfaction](https://www.benefitspro.com/2001/12/11/deluxe-training-tool-helps-boost-member-satisfaction): Deluxe Financial releases CD-ROM training tool for check selection tips
